sentiment: Every trusted color is a small square someone agreed to keep still, and the far shore is reached only on the second try.

stories.title: Isar Aerospace reaches orbit and deploys payloads on second flight
stories.summary: A small company's second rocket reached orbit and let its payloads go — proof that a first attempt's fire is tuition, and that the far shore belongs to whoever loads the rocket and tries again.

stories.title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
stories.summary: A project trying to make self-hosting feel like an ordinary, reachable thing instead of a rite of passage — the patient work of lowering the ledge so more people can climb.

stories.title: The ColorChecker, photography's most important 24 squares, turns 50
stories.summary: For half a century photographers have pointed their cameras at the same small squares so that every image agrees on what red means — a quiet, patient contract between light and memory.
